notes.title: ANIME STANDING in now on gamepad & bugs fix!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36881841/66a518f1379f15e2ad898b29fe3876da327104d3.png[/img]

After seeing some of the bugs messages popping out in our community, we share the same annoyance you are having.. And it just wouldn’t do! So we fixed those, plus added a few extras here and there:

[list]
[*]access the [b]cybertruck[/b] easily after all the missions end — the vehicle won't disappear anywhere from the very last base
[*]the [b]graphic settings[/b] in your game will be set as 'max' by default
[*][b]mouse sensitivity [/b]is now under your control (check game's 'Settings'), along with the 'inverted mouse' option
[*][b]music settings[/b] also became more flexible: now you can change things up both from the 'Pause' and 'Settings'
[*]you have a choice to turn the [b]'Motion Blur'[/b] on/off
[/list]

[h2]And the best thing as of now: ANIME STANDING now fully supports the gamepad![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36881841/b2444f76b618687fa4ce80301c772aab1ddba848.png[/img]

Additionally, we would like to remind you that this game features [b]free Nudity DLC[/b] if case you've missed it:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1309110/ANIME_STANDING__Nudity_DLC_18/

We wish you the best gaming!

Cheers, 
Konnichiwa Games
